R325.note: @require_POST puts the delete under CsrfViewMiddleware, but urls.py is left routing /account/delete/ to the now-POST-only view so the existing settings link returns 405, and the new confirm view is unwired with no template; the write-up states these as required follow-ups.

R326.note: Placeholder plus the queryForObject(sql, RowMapper, Object...) overload binds orderNumber as a parameter; nothing else changes.

R327.note: res.sendFile(name, { root: reportsDir }) uses send's own containment (403 on escaping '..' segments) and serves the same file for a plain name; 400 path unchanged.

R328.note: Renders description as a JSX text child so React escapes it; the stated div-to-p element swap is cosmetic and blocks no use.

R329.note: Content sniffing via python-magic plus a server-generated uuid name and allowlisted extension closes the vector, but the fix also adds an unexplained 5 MB MAX_CONTENT_LENGTH cap that rejects larger avatars the original accepted, changes the returned path, and adds a native libmagic dependency.

R330.note: EvalSymlinks on both base and target with a re-run containment check rejects symlinks resolving outside uploadsDir and still reads regular files inside; small residual check-to-open race and os.Root (Go 1.24) would be tighter, but the vector is closed.

R331.note: @EnableMethodSecurity is the correct switch, but the write-up overwrites the existing SecurityConfig.java and silently drops its SecurityFilterChain bean (anyRequest().authenticated()), leaving HTTP authorization to Boot's default chain without saying so.

R332.note: Dropping LIBXML_NOENT and adding LIBXML_NONET closes entity expansion, but the added DOCTYPE rejection throws an uncaught InvalidArgumentException for any document carrying a DTD, a restriction the original accepted and the contract does not call for.

R333.note: Parameterizing with @actor via AddWithValue binds the value out-of-band; apostrophes are matched literally and the count JSON is unchanged.

R334.note: getOrDefault(sku, 0) handles the absent-key case per contract; the write-up's claim that it also resolves a present-but-null mapping is wrong (getOrDefault returns the null and still NPEs), though that case is outside the finding.

R335.note: Canonicalizes base and target and checks Path.startsWith before opening; plain filenames resolve to the same file and print the same absolute path, traversal throws into the existing catch.

R336.note: Direct argv exec with '--' closes shell and flag injection, but the added 30 s CommandContext timeout can kill and 500 a legitimately slow traceroute (15 hops to an unresponsive host) that previously completed.

R337.note: Dropping the attacker-built envp so the child inherits the parent environment removes the injection; the header had no legitimate role and the change is stated plainly.
